format: glTF2 binary skeletal GLB via official GltfMeshFormat/SkeletalMeshDto
basis: output=(UE.X,UE.Z,UE.Y)*0.01; normals/tangents swappedYZ and normalized by official converter
materialPolicy: slot names and exact DF references sidecars; GLB neutral placeholders only, no guessed PBR
lod: highest available sourceLOD, recorded per model
collision: GLB has no collision. BodySetup JSON sidecar when available, no promise native physics reconstruction
